common_cold.name: Common Cold
common_cold.description: The common cold is a mild infection that commonly affects the nose and throat.
self_care: Use warm fluids to soothe the throat
prevention: Avoid close contact with people who are sick
Avoid touching your eyes, nose and mouth with unwashed hands
common_cold.medical_help: Seek medical advice if symptoms are severe, persistent, or getting worse.
common_cold.medicine_note: Ask a qualified healthcare professional or pharmacist before using medicines.

headache.name: Headache
headache.description: A headache is pain or discomfort in the head or surrounding areas. It can have many possible causes.
symptoms: Pain or pressure in the head
headache.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional if headaches are frequent, severe, persistent, or unusual for you.
headache.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional or pharmacist whether any medicine is appropriate for you.

fever.name: Fever
fever.description: Fever is an increase in body temperature and can occur when the body is responding to an infection or another condition.
prevention: Avoid close contact with people who are sick
fever.medical_help: Seek medical advice if fever is severe, persistent, or accompanied by concerning symptoms.
fever.medicine_note: Do not self-prescribe medicines. Ask a healthcare professional or pharmacist for appropriate advice.

diabetes.name: Diabetes
diabetes.description: Diabetes is a condition in which blood glucose levels are too high because the body does not produce enough insulin or does not use insulin effectively.
self_care: Stay physically active according to professional advice
diabetes.medical_help: People with symptoms or concerns about diabetes should consult a healthcare professional for proper evaluation and testing.
diabetes.medicine_note: Diabetes treatment should be guided by a qualified healthcare professional. Do not change prescribed treatment without medical advice.

hypertension.name: High Blood Pressure
hypertension.description: High blood pressure, also called hypertension, occurs when blood pressure remains higher than the recommended range over time.
symptoms: High blood pressure may have no noticeable symptoms
Regular blood pressure measurement is important
hypertension.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional if blood pressure readings remain high or you have concerns about your blood pressure.
hypertension.medicine_note: Do not start, stop, or change blood pressure medicines without professional medical advice.

asthma.name: Asthma
asthma.description: Asthma is a condition that affects the airways and can cause episodes of breathing difficulty.
self_care: Follow the asthma management plan provided by a healthcare professional
asthma.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional for recurring breathing symptoms or asthma management.
asthma.medicine_note: Asthma medicines should be used according to a healthcare professional's instructions.

stomach_pain.name: Stomach Pain
stomach_pain.description: Stomach or abdominal pain can have many possible causes, ranging from temporary digestive problems to conditions requiring medical evaluation.
symptoms: Pain or discomfort in the abdomen
self_care: Eat light and balanced meals if comfortable
Monitor whether symptoms improve or worsen
prevention: Avoid foods that consistently cause discomfort
stomach_pain.medical_help: Seek medical advice if stomach pain is severe, persistent, recurring, or accompanied by concerning symptoms.
stomach_pain.medicine_note: Avoid self-prescribing medicines for unexplained abdominal pain. Consult a healthcare professional when needed.

flu.name: Flu
flu.description: Influenza, commonly called flu, is a viral respiratory infection that can cause more intense symptoms than a typical common cold.
prevention: Avoid close contact with sick people
flu.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms are severe, persistent, or getting worse.
flu.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional or pharmacist about appropriate treatment options.

cough.name: Cough
cough.description: A cough is a protective reflex that helps clear the airways. It can occur with infections, allergies, asthma, or other conditions.
cough.medical_help: Seek medical advice if the cough is severe, persistent, or associated with concerning symptoms.
cough.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional or pharmacist before using cough medicines.

sore_throat.name: Sore Throat
sore_throat.description: A sore throat is irritation or pain in the throat and can occur with viral infections and other conditions.
prevention: Avoid close contact with people who are sick
Avoid sharing personal items with someone who is ill
sore_throat.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms are severe, persistent, or getting worse.
sore_throat.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional or pharmacist about appropriate treatment.

allergy.name: Allergy
allergy.description: An allergy occurs when the immune system reacts to a substance that is usually harmless to most people.
allergy.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional if allergy symptoms are frequent, severe, or difficult to manage.
allergy.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional or pharmacist about appropriate allergy treatment.

dehydration.name: Dehydration
dehydration.description: Dehydration occurs when the body loses more fluid than it takes in.
self_care: Rest in a cool environment if overheated
prevention: Drink more during hot weather or physical activity
Pay attention to signs of thirst
dehydration.medical_help: Seek medical advice if dehydration is severe, persistent, or symptoms are worsening.
dehydration.medicine_note: If you are unsure what fluids or treatment are appropriate, consult a healthcare professional.

diarrhea.name: Diarrhea
diarrhea.description: Diarrhea involves loose or watery stools and can have many possible causes, including infections and digestive problems.
diarrhea.medical_help: Seek medical advice if diarrhea is severe, persistent, or accompanied by concerning symptoms.
diarrhea.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional before using medicines for diarrhea, especially for children or persistent symptoms.

constipation.name: Constipation
constipation.description: Constipation means having bowel movements less often than usual or having difficulty passing hard stools.
prevention: Eat a balanced diet with adequate fiber
constipation.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional if constipation is persistent, severe, or repeatedly returns.
constipation.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional or pharmacist before using laxatives or other medicines.

acid_reflux.name: Acid Reflux
acid_reflux.description: Acid reflux occurs when stomach contents move back toward the food pipe and may cause a burning sensation or discomfort.
symptoms: Burning sensation in the chest or upper abdomen
self_care: Avoid meals that consistently trigger symptoms
Avoid lying down immediately after eating
prevention: Avoid eating immediately before lying down
acid_reflux.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms are frequent, persistent, or worsening.
acid_reflux.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional or pharmacist about suitable treatment options.

migraine.name: Migraine
migraine.description: Migraine is a neurological condition that can cause recurring headaches and other symptoms.
self_care: Identify and avoid personal triggers when possible
migraine.medical_help: Consult a healthcare professional if headaches are frequent, severe, persistent, or unusual.
migraine.medicine_note: Ask a healthcare professional about appropriate migraine treatment.
